'''Frira''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as a [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. She had a base on [[Carrick Station]].

==Behind the scenes==
Frira appears in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Slicing crew skill trainer on Carrick Station.
